ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 75% of the surface area, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the peduncle base and along the peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white regions cover the lateral lobes. A central dark pigmentation zone extends from the peduncle in a wide V-shape. Multiple dark linear and amorphous spots are distributed across the white field, notably a cluster in the lower-left quadrant and streaks on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, well-defined V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees, extending significantly toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge features a major high-amplitude indentation (likely tissue loss) followed by irregular, high-frequency serrations. The right lobe exhibits more consistent, lower-amplitude serrations with a jagged, 'saw-tooth' profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edges meeting at sharp, upwardly-tapered tips; the overall fluke profile displays a wide, sweeping 'S' curve from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark, amorphous pixel clusters at the base of the fluke and scattered dark spotting on the lower interior regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, unaligned linear marks (rake-like scratches) are visible on the mid-section of the right lobe and lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large-scale irregular indentation and tissue loss on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe; additional fragmented morphology on the outer tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The highly irregular, 'torn' appearance of the left trailing edge is a unique identifier compared to the relatively intact right trailing edge.
